evidence_quotes.two_concerns_question: Never asked. Rep moved directly into logistics and special items probing without establishing customer concerns first.
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Not applicable — no concerns were surfaced by the customer during the call.
evidence_quotes.value_days: Never addressed. No mention of different day options or pricing savings.
evidence_quotes.rate_lock_then_ask: Rep mentioned 'to secure a spot there's no deposit required' but then asked 'would you like me to get you on the schedule?' without a rate lock statement. When customer declined to book, rep simply offered to email the quote without reasserting the ask or clarifying the no-deposit/rate-lock position.

top_strength: Nicole clearly explained the all-inclusive pricing model, travel fee, damage coverage, meet-your-mover feature, and on-time guarantee with specific dollar amounts and terms, giving Samantha a comprehensive understanding of what Einstein offers.
coaching_note: Skip the feature recitation and start with the two-concerns question before probing — this moves the conversation from what you do to what matters to the customer, and creates the opening for Two Promises to land when it will actually resonate.
